description: A catalogue of interactive maps and downloadable spatial data from the USGS for regional and global mineral resource analysis. The mrdata home page lists datasets under mineral resources, geology, geochemistry and geophysics, with map interfaces for the conterminous US, Alaska and the world, and WMS, WFS, WMTS and API access. Mineral resource entries include USMIN, the Mineral Resources Data System (MRDS), Alaska mines and prospects, major nonfuel deposits, critical mineral locations from Professional Paper 1802, undiscovered deposit estimates, porphyry and sediment-hosted copper worldwide, VMS and sediment-hosted zinc-lead deposit models, Earth MRI data, and active mines and mineral plants in the US; geochemistry covers the National Geochemical Database for rocks, sediments, soils and concentrates. Each entry has a "Download + details" page; the site is free to use. Coverage is the United States, with some global and other countries' datasets. Caveats: licence and formats differ by dataset and are not given on the home page, and some layers are historic. For simulation it is the index of US mine, plant and deposit layers, to place mining assets and supply chains against hazards. Related catalogue records include the USGS Mineral Resources Data System and the USGS USMIN mine features.
